name: Tumble Olivia Ivory/Neutral washable rug and cushioned pad, 9x12

dimensions.raw: Size: 9x12' (the size chooser's variant, $549); Rug thickness: 1/8"; Rug pad thickness: 1/4"
dimensions.source: the product page's size chooser and Specifications, read in Chrome 2026-10-26 (a rug: the short side is w by convention here, placed by rotation; h left out, 3/8" rug and pad together)

notes: Andrew, 2026-10-26 (night): "I think we need something like a ruggable so that it's thin enough and separate from the padding to allow actually washing"; then "What color / size for each room? tell me". Tumble (tumbleliving.com, read in Chrome 2026-10-26; no photo: the host is off the image allowlist): a two-piece washable system, a 1/8" thick 100% polyester rug with a spillproof face (liquids bead up) on a separate 1/4" cushioned non-slip pad (EVA foam core, TPR surfaces) that tucks into corner pockets; the pad is included in the price ("Pad included - $179 value" at 8x10). Care: "All rug sizes fit into a standard household washer and dryer", cold cycle, standard detergent, dry on low heat; sweep or vacuum under the pad every 3 months; "We don't recommend using autonomous robot vacuums as they've been known to damage the rug's edges". Prices, the same for every design read: 9x12 $549, 8x10 $399, 6x9 $349, 5x7 $199, 3x5 $129, runners $149 and $199. Free shipping and 30-day returns. Color notes on the page: "Light ivory ground is more cool toned than warm toned and casts as a very light grey in certain lighting. Accents are white, taupe, khaki, & brown"; hand-drawn floral motifs with a subtle texture. THE PICK for the living room (F-68): a pale cool-ivory field lifts the dark gray MORABO and the walnut UGGLERUM off the honey oak, its taupe and khaki florals pick up the sage and off-white accents, and it is the sibling of the dining room's gray Canyon in one sightline. Same footprint as the Homemate 9x12 (x 33 to 177, y 35 to 143), every leg of the sofa group on it. Sold on Amazon as amazon-B0HCN6RMWS at the same price (Andrew, 2026-10-26: "tumble rug is orderable on amazon! pretty convenient we should prefer that"): the Amazon record is the one placed and the one to order; this one is the maker's reference.
